- The EZ Work Permit Website (外國專業人員工作許可申辦網) is the online portal for applying for a student work permit. [3]
- It offers a 24‑hour submission, payment, notification, and inquiry service. [3]
- The application is managed by the Labor Development Agency (勞動力發展署). [3]
- The maximum fine for a student who works without a work permit is NT$15, and the permit can be revoked if the employer fails to apply or fails to work within 6 months. [4]
- The introduction process of receiving work permits can be found in Chapter 7 Receive the Electronic Document [1]
- The application fee can be paid via postal remittance (劃撥戶名：勞動部勞動力發展署聘僱許可收費專戶，劃撥帳號：19058848）或 via ATM (使用ATM繳費，於取得ATM繳費序號後即時繳納) [2]

- Foreign students who earn an associate degree or higher in Taiwan can apply to extend their stay in the country for up to two years. [1]
- The entrance to the National Development Council in Taipei is pictured in an undated photo. [1]

- 1990 [1]
- 業務諮詢一覽表（1990 外來人士在臺生活諮詢服務熱線） [1]

- Call 3C (Calm Down, Check it out, Call 165) for scams that use high‑money, online work, or high‑paying博弈. [4]
- For example, use the 3C principle: Calm Down, Check it out, Call 165. [4]

- If an employer does not enroll a student worker in labor insurance, they may be fined 4× the labor insurance fee and 10× the employment insurance fee for the period the employer fails to enroll. [1]
- If the employer fails to enroll a student worker, they may be fined 4× the labor insurance fee and 10× the employment insurance fee for the period the employer fails to enroll. [5]

- A bachelor's degree takes 4 years and at least 128 credits in total. [3]
- Your department may require more; its curriculum table has the exact number. [3]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [3]

- 12 additional graduation credits are required for overseas students admitted on an equivalent qualification from a foreign, Hong Kong, or Macau school, with a graduation period of 12 years. [4]
- Military training and physical education courses do not count toward these 12 credits. [4]
- The additional credits must be earned after the previous year's general education credits are satisfied. [4]
- For more details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [4]

- At least 16 credits each semester in years one to three and at least 9 credits each semester in year four. [5]
- Taking fewer credits requires approval from your advisor and department head; without it you can be dismissed. [5]

- International students must take the full‑year five‑credit course "Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students" (僑生國文) [1]
- They are not required to take the Chinese (B): Chinese Writing course [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw [1]

- Take 6 credits of Mandarin courses at the Language Center instead of the freshman Chinese. [2]
- File for the Chinese course substitution before you graduate. [2]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [2]

- PE is required for five semesters: Freshman PE I and II plus three PE interest electives. It carries no graduation credits, and you cannot repeat an elective with the same title. [3]
- After the five semesters you may take a 1-credit PE course, which also does not count toward graduation. [3]

- A master's degree requires at least 24 credits, not counting thesis credits. [4]
- You must take at least one graduate course of 1 credit or more at NCU; waived courses do not count. [4]

- Students admitted directly into a doctoral program need at least 34 credits, of which at least 18 must be doctoral-level credits, not counting dissertation credits. [5]
- The total credits required for students admitted directly into a doctoral program must be at least 34 credits, with at least 18 of those being doctoral-level credits. [5]

- Apply before the add/drop deadline of your first semester; the application will be reviewed individually. [1]
- If approved, you will skip both semesters of Freshman English and receive 6 credits that count toward graduation. [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Undergraduates must complete at least 100 service hours on the NCU passport before receiving the degree certificate. [2]
- You can check your hours on the Service Learning Website (https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/) or in the Graduation System (https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/). [2]
- If you have a change in your residential address, you must apply for registration of the change within 30 days from the day after the change occurs. [2]
- Failure to apply within the specified period will result in a fine ranging from NTD 2,000 to NTD 10,000. [2]

- Service learning is not listed among the graduation conditions for master's and doctoral students. [4]
- The graduation conditions are courses and credits, the degree examination, and conduct grades. [4]
- Individual departments may set additional requirements. [4]
- For more information, contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (學務處服務學習發展中心) at https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/. [4]

- The service-learning course is a zero-credit required course that must be taken in two semesters. [5]
- The course numbers of both courses of student service-learning taken by a student shall not be identical. [5]
- For more information, contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (學務處服務學習發展中心) at https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/. [5]

- TOEFL ITP score of 500 (admitted 114 or earlier) or 785 (Listening 400, Reading 385) (admitted 115 or later) [3]
- TOEFL ITP score of 483 (admitted 114 or earlier) or 543 (admitted 115 or later) [3]
- TOEIC LR score of 600 (admitted 114 or earlier) or 785 (Listening 400, Reading 385) (admitted 115 or later) [3]
- TOEIC LR score of 785 (Listening 400, Reading 385) (admitted 115 or later) [3]

- TOEIC LR: 600 (admitted 110 or later) [2]
- TOEFL ITP: 483 (admitted 110 or later) [2]
- TOEFL IBT: 64 (2026-01-21 起) from 2026-01-21 起 (admitted 110 or later) [2]
- IELTS: 5.0 (admitted 110 or later) [2]
- GEPT HI First: 143 (admitted 110 or later) [2]
- BESTEP LR: 170 (admitted 110 or later) [2]

- The program requires an English proficiency certificate at CEFR B1 (Threshold) or above. [3]
- For example, TOEFL iBT: 42; IELTS: 4; TOEIC: 550; GEPT: Intermediate. [3]
- Applicants from an English‑speaking country are exempt from providing an English proficiency certificate. [3]
- The program is taught in Chinese. [3]

- The Ph.D. in Institute of Network Learning Technology (網路學習科技研究所博士班) is offered by the College of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (資電學院) [2]
- The program is taught in English (english_sufficient) and requires a total of 24 credits, including 18 elective credits and 6 required credits [2]
- The program duration is 4 years [2]
- Regulations can be found at https://www.lst.ncu.edu.tw/NLT_new/page.php?slug=method&lang=en [2]
- Mon-Fri 9:00-17:00 (Taipei time, UTC+8) [2]

- The IIPP Program is an international internship program that offers a 2025-quality internship opportunities. [3]
- The TEEP Program is an international internship program that offers a 2025-quality internship opportunities. [3]

- The monthly stipend of NT$10,000 (up to 2 years) is provided by the industry partner. [4]

- The application period for the INTENSE Program is from October 1 to October 22, 2026. [5]

- Bring your student ID or passport/visa/ARC (only for first-time applicants) [2]
- OIA will submit the documents to Cathay Insurance for processing the medical subsidy [2]

- The fee for the Taiwan Area Residence Certificate for a Hong Kong or Macau student applying for the first time is NT$1,000 per item per year. [4]
- The entry-exit permit fee for a Hong Kong/Macau student is NT$1,000 per item per year. [4]

- The Cathay Life medical insurance fee per semester for overseas Chinese students is 3,000 NTD. [2]
- If you are not eligible for National Health Insurance, you must pay the Cathay Life medical insurance at 3,000 NTD. [2]

- You must enroll on the day you have resided in Taiwan for 6 months, or on the day you start employment (no waiting period). [5]
- You can enroll on the day you start employment (no waiting period). [5]
- If you work short-term for less than 3 months, you may keep your original enrollment. [5]
- If you work for more than 30 days or more than twice, your eligibility date will be recounted. [5]

- Mainland Chinese students who are eligible for National Health Insurance should pay TWD 4,956. [1]
- Foreign students with a National Health Insurance IC Card pay TWD 3,000. [5]
- Application period for Fall 2026 Semester: July 6th to July 20th, 12:00 PM, 2026 [1]

- 申請以「其他」事由延期居留1年，可再申請一次，總延期居留效期最長可達2年。 [1]

- 若未及時變更居留原因，原居留證將被廢止，可能面臨逾期罰鍰或限期出境。 [1]

- 學士班畢業至少 128 學分 [1]
- 依系所規定，至少要修滿二十四學分 [1]
- 至少要修一門 1 學分以上的研究所課程（抵免課程） [1]

- 學士班學生須完成中大護照 100 基本時數，否則無法領取學位證書。 [2]
- 可於【服務學習網】或【畢業審核系統】查詢完成時數。 [2]
- 如有疑問，請洽學務處服務學習發展中心。 [2]

- 115 學年度入學的學生，托福 ITP 需取得 543 分，或 115 學年度入學的學生，托福 ITP 需取得 4–4.5 分。 [4]

- IELTS 5.5 分，GEPT HI First 聽、讀通過，BESTEP LR 聽力 100–114、閱讀 100–114 (admitted 115 or later). [4]
- 僑生保險期滿後，尚未符合參加全民健保資格者，應自費參加國泰人壽醫療保險，一學期(六個月)新台幣3,000元，就醫及理賠申請規定同僑保，至符合參加全民健保資格。 [2]

- 每個工作日皆到工或每週工時達12小時者視同專任員工，應由雇主為其投保。 [4]
- 僑生、外籍生（以下稱僑外生）在臺參加健保注意事項。 [4]
